items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 22 July 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 to 5, becoming 4 or 5 in most waters for a time this evening and overnight, but occasionally increasing 6 to the west and southwest of the Isle of Man at first tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at times.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 or 4, but occasionally 5 in the northeast of the area at first, backing west 3 or 4 by dawn on Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
